note: Gravel sites in open grass beside a small pond with a sand beach, just off I-90/94 at Tomah. A rail line runs along the northeast edge of the park. ATVs and UTVs may ride from the campsites out onto the local ATV route. About half the sites are seasonal. --Claude

Nightly share 18 of 34 (16 overnight RV + 2 tent) = 53%: passes long-stay tests, seasonal sites 16. Season Apr 15 - Oct 15 confirmed (reopens Apr 15 2027). Count 34 added; max rig 60 kept (sites 60-75 ft; stated range). Hookups 50/W/S, facilities confirmed. Not waterfront kept. ATV route flag (general campground, not a trail base).
flags: Price gate: passes. Ordinary RV site $39 (W/E) - $44 (full hookup). Google 4.6 (87 reviews).

LONG-STAY: nightly share 18 of 34 (53%): booking widget lists Overnight Premium 1-6 and 15-20 (12), Overnight Regular 31-34 (4) and tent T2-T3 (2) by the night; Seasonal 7-12, 14, 21-25, 27-30 (16) at $1,825. Passes; over 50% nightly, so no 'Mostly seasonal' line, but the note says about half are seasonal.

OHV (flag only): home page 'We are located directly on an ATV route so bring along your ATV/UTV and enjoy the beautiful scenery of Wisconsin'; rule 16 lets ATVs/UTVs ride from the campsite 'to a destination out of the campground'. This is a county/town road ATV route, not a trail system; the park markets general camping (Tomah, cranberry country, Dells). Kept as a general campground; reviewer decides.
